description: Searches for models across platforms. Thingiverse uses its official API (requires THINGIVERSE_TOKEN). MakerWorld and Printables have no official public API, so for them only a search link is returned for a person to open; this is a deliberate downgrade: no scraping or private endpoints pretending to be an API. Do not claim to have searched or downloaded models from those platforms. Does not download any model. Accesses the internet.

sources.description: Restrict to these platforms; omit to query all. See catalogs in bambu_get_status for the available values.

name: bambu_search_models
title: Search for 3D models
